b: Exciting changes are coming to The Poetry School!
We are pleased to announce that we will be moving to a brand new website and digital learning platform very soon!

The current website was built in 2015 and we were limited by the technology available to us at that time. As the years went by, our courses have developed, our programme has expanded, technology has advanced, and the efficacy of the platform fell behind. This led to a number of students and tutors experiencing difficulties with our courses (both with booking and participating).

Over the years we’ve tried incredibly hard to keep the current website operating and provided lots of advice and guides to our users; however, we have now reached point where we are unable to manage this site any further and need to bring in a whole new website and online learning platform to ensure our students and tutors have the best experience. As we are also approaching our 30th year, this timing feels right!

Our new website is going to fix a number of issues and provide an overall better experience, from booking your place to participating in our courses. We know this will lead to a lot of questions regarding this current site and how booking will work for Spring courses, so we have done our best to provide some initial answers below:
What this means for Spring Term 2027

We will still be launching our Spring term this month (although it will be a little later than usual!). However, as we are still getting our new website ready before officially going live to the general public, our Spring courses will only be available for subscribers to book directly through our newsletter. You can find out more about our Spring launch here.
Our Spring term launch newsletter will be sent out on Monday 23 November. If you are not signed up, please click the ‘subscribe’ button below:

If you are not sure whether you are signed up, check you received our most recent newsletter which was sent out on 27 October. If you didn’t receive this you may need to sign up again. Please also make sure our emails come to your main inbox by marking us as a ‘safe sender’ (in case they land in your junk folder and get missed!).

We know there will be a lot of questions and we will do our best to help and support you with any queries you may have. As the website hasn’t officially launched yet, there are some questions we may be unable to answer immediately, but our team will do our best to answer some of the initial queries:
How long will this website be active?

The current website will be taken down on 11 January 2027. This means you have until this date to save any assignments/documents/poems from previous courses that you would like to access again in the future. Unfortunately, anything not saved or downloaded by this date will be lost, so do make sure to save anything you want to keep. If you would like to remain in touch with any friends you’ve made through the site/courses, we would recommend exchanging contact details to keep in touch if you would like to.
Will I be able to access old Online courses and assignments on the new website?

Unfortunately we will be starting fresh on this new website, so you will not be able to access any of your old Online courses on the new website. Please refer to the guidance above regarding old assignments.
Will you still have access to my order history?

The new website will come with a new database and we’ll be starting from scratch, so this means that unfortunately we will no longer be able to assist with queries regarding to previous course purchases you have made.
What about the non-course groups on the current website?

Sadly, our non-course groups will no longer be available. Due to the size of them and the amount that has been uploaded over the years, this has resulted in several glitching problems which unfortunately we are unable to manage.

At the moment there are no plans to continue non-course groups on our new site, so if you have made friends through these online communities we would encourage you to exchange to contact details to keep in touch.
Will there be many changes to how the courses work?

Our Zoom courses will work in the same way as before, however, where you may have previously used a CAMPUS Group or GDrive for sharing poems and accessing handouts, you will now do this on our new learning platform platform.
The new learning platform will be similar to CAMPUS in many ways, but there will be some changes too, which we will provide more details on in the new year to ensure you’re all set for Spring.
Whilst we don’t have all the answers ourselves yet, if you have a query that’s relevant to our new or current website that hasn’t been answered above, please submit it here.

Please note we won’t be able to respond to these queries directly, but this will give us an idea of what information to provide and, if it is relevant, we will make sure to address it and update this page accordingly.

We know that change can be overwhelming and we want to do our best to support our students and tutors through this transition as much as possible. However, please do remember we are a small team and this site will be brand new to us too, meaning we might not have all the answers immediately, so please be patient and kind in any communications with us – thankyou!
